review: Context manifests need a concrete assembly order and a memory lifecycle that includes corrections and deletion.
build: Assemble a request from instructions, user input, authorized evidence, and one retrieved memory. Print a safe manifest of origins and token estimates without private text. Run the owner-scoped temporal memory exercise; introduce a late preference correction, a cross-owner query and an expiry/deletion. Record which source revision is selected and why.
verify: An expired preference is excluded, a corrected preference supersedes the old value, and untrusted document instructions never become privileged instructions. Command: `python3 -B labs/agent_memory_lifecycle.py`. Observe `PASS`, then describe one denied cross-tenant lookup, a replay collision and one deletion limit (backups/replicas are not verified).
